mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing mainly clear skies and a pleasant 74 degrees near Harriet Park, with a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

In city news, the common council recently approved new sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting and well-maintained. Also, remember that the planning department requires all application fees to be paid by check, and you should be wary of any online payment requests.

There is plenty to do, including the Epic Systems UGM and Hop Haus trivia taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market or join trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on Saturday, August 15, an officer arrested a 29-year-old man for his second O W I offence after a citizen reported him as a reckless driver.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a sweet treat.
